## Scope

This is Mason Nguyen's canonical authorship and research site. It publishes definitions, frameworks, essays, and source notes concerning Generative Engine Optimization, Autonomous Resource Management, entity architecture, and accountable AI systems.

The site does not sell services or accept payment. Commercial work is handled by distinct operating properties:

These organizations are related application paths. They are not alternate identities for Mason Nguyen and must not be interpreted as Person sameAs values.
